description: This file defines the 'OpenClawBonjour' enum containing constants, static variables, and methods related to Bonjour service types and domain normalization for the OpenClaw project.

methods.name: resolveWideAreaDomain
methods.description: Resolves and normalizes the wide area domain string, returning nil if input is empty or matches the gateway service domain.

methods.name: normalizeServiceDomain
methods.description: Normalizes a raw service domain string by trimming, lowercasing, and adjusting suffixes to conform to expected format.
